reviews.title: Worth it! Good for work and Gaming
reviews.comment: LOVE THIS MONITOR! I got it on sale for $169 and I just absolutely love it. The colors are so clean and so clear. It’s so beautiful and vibrant. It was very easy to set up and easy to adjust.

reviews.title: VERY SATISFIED WITH MY PURCHASE
reviews.comment: Very easy to install. Good picture. The cables that come with it is always a plus.  REALLY GOOD MONITOR.
reviews.author: Denise Valenzuela

reviews.title: Solid Monitor
reviews.comment: Love the monitor!  Looks great and did not take much calibration. Decently high refresh rate for gaming and a perfect size in my opinion.
reviews.author: Steven S.

reviews.title: Great picture
reviews.comment: Monitor is great as far as pictured quality goes. No dead pixels, everything is sharp, clear, and vibrant. I hope it lasts at least 10 years. I'm still adjusting to the 2560x1440 resolution, but I am so glad for it. Tested a few games with it and it was also amazing. The stand is pretty cheap. The small loop in the back for cable management arrived broken, and honestly not sure how easily cables would have fit through it. I think the company figures most people will disregard the stand and mount it anyway. So you can only tilt the monitor back slightly and nothing else. That being said, I really like it so far. Settings are straight forward and BDO looks and feels amazing on it. Great budget friendly monitor.
reviews.author: Carrie

reviews.title: Good overall quality for the price.
reviews.comment: Replaced my AOC 27" that I had for 6 years with this monitor. I like it so far, good quality, adjustability and I like the stand better.
